**REG-J′_k**: a saturated colouring whose singular set Σ is locally finite, **each point of Σ meeting finitely many interface arcs** (the clause two briefs dropped)
every essential boundary point is at distance exactly 1 from the support of each colour of its essential multicolour
an honest (one colour per point) saturated one

every partition of the plane, up to a null set, into k measurable sets each maximal among measurable sets with null unit pairs (a measurable idomatic partition of the unit-distance graph, the classes of a measurable fall colouring) is an honest saturated a.e.-proper k-colouring

every component R of an open class of a saturated honest colouring has at least two points on its minimal enclosing circle, and at none of     them does M-PINCH's conclusion hold for R's colour: each is a cusp of R or a point where (H1) or (H2) fails
